exposure: ICD-9-CM to ICD-10-CM/PCS coding system transition
outcome: identification of delivery episodes by different coding systems (diagnosis codes, normal delivery codes, DRG codes, procedure codes)
cohort: The study included 673,978 delivery hospitalizations recorded in public hospitals in Portugal from 2010 to 2018.
finding: The transition from ICD-9-CM to ICD-10-CM/PCS had a limited impact on overall delivery hospitalization trends but significantly affected procedure coding.
